faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Get to know Zo7al, find his videos and social accounts, and learn about the server, store and gaming projects.

items.q: What is ZO7AL Network?
items.a: A Minecraft server and gaming universe built by Zo7al, spanning survival, PvP, modpacks and Fortnite Creative maps.

items.q: How do I join Zo7al Network on Java?
items.a: Copy the Java address, zo7al.play-mc.fun, from the Minecraft page and add it as a server in Minecraft Java Edition's multiplayer menu.

items.q: How do I join Zo7al Network on Bedrock?
items.a: Add a server in Minecraft Bedrock with address zo7al.play-mc.fun and port 25807.

items.q: Is Bedrock supported?
items.a: Yes. Bedrock: zo7al.play-mc.fun — port 25807.

items.q: What Minecraft versions are supported?
items.a: 1.8.9 for classic PvP, 1.20.x for stable survival, and 1.21.x for the latest release line.

items.q: What kind of videos do you make?
items.a: Gaming videos and Shorts: Fortnite, Minecraft and other games, challenges, funny moments and playing with friends. Find my channel on YouTube at @iiZo7al.

items.q: How do I buy a rank?
items.a: Open /store, choose a rank, enter your Minecraft username and complete payment securely through Tebex. Booster is obtained by boosting our Discord server.

items.q: What ranks are available?
items.a: Paid ranks are VIP, MVP, MVP+ and MVP++. Booster is obtained by boosting the Discord server. Creator ranks YOUTUBE, TWITCH and TIKTOK are available through application and review, not purchase. Visit /store for current details, prices and applications. Coins packages are in-game currency, not ranks.

items.q: Where is the Zo7al Network store?
items.a: Open the Store page at /store. Payments are processed through Tebex, and subscriptions can be viewed or cancelled at portal.tebex.io.

items.q: How do I buy Coins, and can I buy them again?
items.a: Open /store and choose a package in Coins. Enter your exact Minecraft username and pay through Tebex. The package details show the amount and any bonus. Coins are in-game currency, separate from ranks, and can be purchased more than once. If delivery is delayed, contact Discord support with your transaction reference.

items.q: How do I join a Zo7al Fortnite map?
items.a: Open Fortnite, go to Creative, select "Enter a code", and type in the island code shown on any map on the Fortnite page.

items.q: Where can I find all Zo7al maps?
items.a: The Fortnite page lists every published island with its code, kept in sync with the official creator page.

items.q: What is the official Zo7al Discord server?
items.a: discord.gg/nxScVYrSXq — the hub for events, support and community updates.

items.q: Where can I find Zo7al's social media?
items.a: Find my YouTube channel @iiZo7al and my other accounts on the Socials page. The account links sync from my official Linktree.

items.q: How do I report a problem?
items.a: Join the Discord server and open a ticket in the support channel — that's the fastest way to reach the team.

items.q: How do I contact Zo7al?
items.a: For advertising and collaborations, email ads@zo7al.net. For server or purchase support, join our Discord through the Socials page.

items.q: Where can I download Zo7al modpacks?
items.a: On Modrinth and CurseForge — both are listed with direct links on the Modpacks page.

items.q: How do I preview the latest content from Zo7al’s accounts?
items.a: Open /socials and select the details icon on any account, including Zo7al Games. Each preview shows the account bio and platform-specific public content when available, such as a long YouTube video, a post, a saved Twitch broadcast or a modpack release.

items.q: Why is a social preview sometimes unavailable?
items.a: Some platforms restrict public previews, require an API connection, or have no public content available. Use the link in the preview to open the original account. A missing preview does not mean the account was deleted.

items.q: How do I apply for a creator rank?
items.a: Open /store and find Creator ranks below Coins. Choose YouTube, Twitch or TikTok, then submit your email, Minecraft and Discord usernames, channel link and content details. The team reviews your application; submission does not grant a rank automatically.

items.q: Are creator ranks paid?
items.a: No payment is required to apply. These ranks are separate from purchased ranks and Coins. Approval and eligibility are decided by the team; no fixed follower threshold or review time is promised.

description.youtube: From the first clip to the final challenge, share your story with the Zo7al community. The YOUTUBE rank is for Minecraft creators who turn gameplay into videos worth watching: tutorials, experiments, challenges and memorable moments. Introduce your channel, your style and the stories you want to share with your audience on Zo7al Network.
description.twitch: Bring your audience into the experience, one live moment at a time. The TWITCH rank is for Minecraft streamers who combine gameplay with viewer interaction, from survival adventures and exciting matches to community sessions. Introduce your channel, the personality of your streams and how you want to share Zo7al with your audience.
description.tiktok: One clip can tell a whole adventure. The TIKTOK rank is for Minecraft creators who share entertaining moments and quick ideas in their own style, from standout plays and challenges to tips and creative edits. Introduce your profile and your vision for the content you want to create about Zo7al Network.

creators.applicationDetails: To apply, open the application form and provide a reachable email, your Minecraft and Discord usernames, and your profile link on the selected platform. Give accurate content details and explain why you want the rank. With your consent, the application is sent to the Zo7al team through Discord for review. Keep the reference shown after successful delivery. Applying is not a purchase or an automatic rank grant; eligibility and acceptance are decided by the team, with no guaranteed review time or additional benefits.

commonErrors.q: Invalid session / Failed to verify username
commonErrors.a: Close Minecraft, sign out of the launcher and sign in again. Restart the game. If the error persists, send the exact message to support.
Check your internet connection, restart the game and retry. If it continues, report the error, game version and time to support.

commonErrors.q: My rank or coins have not arrived
commonErrors.a: Confirm that payment succeeded and rejoin the server. If the delivery delay exceeds the period listed in the package details, contact support with your order reference.

commonErrors.q: The modpack crashes or will not start
commonErrors.a: Use the version and loader in the project details. Check its published RAM requirements and remove extra mods you added. Include the crash log in your support report.
